raw.title: Battle of Adwa
raw.description: 1896 battle of the First Italo-Ethiopian War
raw.extract: The Battle of Adwa was the climactic battle of the First Italo-Ethiopian War. It was fought on 1 March 1896, near the town of Adwa between the Ethiopian Empire under Emperor Menelik II and an Italian colonial force led by General Oreste Baratieri.
